decisions.reason: Because this vinyl line builds on the firm's existing physical-format catalog and label capabilities, management is likely to keep it while learning from early demand, though its more experimental white-label niche makes discontinuation somewhat more plausible than for a standard catalog release.

This compilation series is very close to the firm's core knowledge in curated archival physical music releases, so under an absorptive-capacity logic the firm is well placed to interpret sales signals and improve or extend the line rather than withdraw it.
